title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText:
7.2. Modify Section 2.7.2 to read as follows:
2.7.2 Fixtures shall not be supported from main runners if the weight of the fixture causes the total dead load to exceed th e
deflection capability of the ceiling suspension system. Fixtures exceeding 80 lbs (36 kg) in weight shall be supported inde pendent
of the ceiling suspension system. Fixtures weighing 80 lbs (36 kg) or less may be supported from the carrying chan nels. Fixtures
weighing 50 lbs (23 kg) or less may be supported from the main runners. Cross runners shall not be used to sup port fixtures.
